name: Betterleaks
description: Installs the Betterleaks secrets scanner from its checksum-verified GitHub release archive and writes no scan configuration.

version.description: Betterleaks version to install: 'latest' (the newest stable release), or a release such as 1.9.0 or a pre-release such as 2.0.0-rc.2 (a leading 'v' is accepted; 1.0.1 or later).
